search_source_notes.careersites_summary: Search executed across 14 career sites and ATS portals for Visual Merchandising roles in Mexico City. Only M·A·C/Estée Lauder Companies (ELC portal at careers.elcompanies.com) was accessible and returned results — 25 jobs, all sales/store management roles. 13 of 14 sites were blocked or returned errors. No dedicated Visual Merchandising positions were identified on any official career page within the search scope.
search_source_notes.elc_portal_details: The ELC/Estée Lauder Companies careers portal (careers.elcompanies.com) was accessed via the M·A·C Cosmetics employment page redirect. Search for 'Visual Merchandising' in Mexico City returned 25 results across 3 pages. All results are sales roles (Counter Manager and Beauty Advisor) for various ELC brands (M·A·C, Balmain Beauty, Tom Ford, Estée Lauder). While Counter Manager JDs include 'Mantenimiento de las directrices de visual merchandising de la marca' as a responsibility, the primary job function is Sales/Point of Sale Management — not Visual Merchandising. Posting ages range from 3 days to 1 month. Roles posted >21 days ago were rejected under posting_age_exceeded rule.
search_source_notes.executive_note: Mauricio's profile (Visual Merchandising career family, CDMX location) found NO matching VM roles on official career pages this cycle. The ELC/M·A·C portal is the only accessible luxury/beauty career site in Mexico and it currently has no dedicated VM postings. Recommendation: rely on LinkedIn (Layer 1) results from this same date for VM opportunities, as 7 valid VM roles were found there.
